I spoke with Alex Tuch this week ahead of his first game against the Sabres. We talked about his impact on Buffalo, the way the season ended, his exit and what Saturday is going to be like. Unlocked this one: 

www.nytimes.com/athl...
What a day to talk with Sal and Adam about the Sabres!

Owen Power has been great to start the season for the Sabres. He’s also playing with a lot on his mind. I spoke to Power about his relationship with Matthew Mayich and how much he’s thinking of him every time he steps on the ice. Free to read:

I believe the Sabres are a good team. But they have a few glaring issues that could hold them back. And a 3-1 loss to the Flyers didn’t quiet the goaltending concerns. Tried to sort through that here:

The Sabres are playing, overall, rather tepid hockey with some dazzlers in there. But they've consistently played behind in games all year and it's exceedingly difficult to dig your way out of a hole every game. Lindy wants them to play connected and things are disjointed right now.
Are you saying the Sabres are playing great hockey that's being blown up by poor goaltending? I hope that's not what you're saying
What if...... I told you the Sabres goalie problem is a whole team problem? Would that tickle you? Would that sate your bloodlust?
Flyers ice the puck with 2:30 left. Sabres pull Luukkonen for the extra attacker.
A pile of mistakes all shift by the Sabres turns into Cole Knuble scoring his second goal of the game banking it in off Luukkonen's skate 3:03 into the third for a 3-1 Flyers lead
